title: The game draws sentry muzzles from the package recipe; lab rounds fly nose first with calibre from tracer size
context: Owner: one master setting for sentries across all modes; in the story the Rotor's muzzle sparks flew far in every direction and read as bullets; in the Sentry / Impact lab both Rotor and Needle fired the same bullet, pointing up rather than at the target; Rotor rounds should be much smaller than Needle's.
outcome: td-tab's tower fire path replaces its own makeDotBurst muzzle (3.2 cells wide) with makeImpactBurst from the package's muzzle recipe, tuneFor and resolveImpactColors, oriented with orientImpact and scaled by cellSide/METRES_PER_CELL, ticked by the existing debris reaper through a group-aware dispose. sentry-tab orients every round mesh along its flight (nose +Y for bullet clouds, +Z for shells) and scales calibre as (projPx/9)^2, giving the Rotor (6 px) 0.44 of the Needle (9 px). Controller size unchanged. A first cut recursed in disposal and was caught by the legacy acceptance.
alternatives: Tune the old dot burst smaller: rejected, it is a second implementation of the muzzle the package already owns.
evidence: legacy acceptance 44 steps PASS after the fix
